skill.name: api-endpoint-creation
skill.description: Create Next.js 15 API endpoints with Supabase, workspace access checks, query filtering, and standard responses.
skill.summary: Build consistent multi-tenant API routes for Next.js and Supabase.
skill.author: CleanExpo

security_audit.summary: All static external command and reconnaissance findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and workspace validation terminology. One semantic issue remains: the example handlers return raw Supabase error messages, which can expose internal backend details in generated endpoints.

remediation.issue: Raw backend errors in generated API route examples
remediation.suggestion: Log full Supabase errors server-side and return generic client messages for 500 responses.

content.value_statement: Teams need consistent API routes that protect workspace data. This skill gives repeatable Next.js and Supabase patterns for validation, queries, and responses.
actual_capabilities: Shows a GET route pattern with workspaceId extraction and validation.
Shows a POST route pattern that records workspace_id and created_by.
Lists required imports for Next.js, Supabase, helpers, and error boundaries.
Provides a checklist for wrappers, workspace filters, responses, errors, and TypeScript types.
Uses standard successResponse and errorResponse helper patterns.
limitations: Does not include PUT, PATCH, DELETE, pagination, or rate limiting examples.
Does not define the helper implementations used by the route patterns.
Does not provide schema validation beyond a simple name check.
Returns backend error messages in examples, which should be sanitized before production.

use_cases.title: Add a Tenant-Scoped Read Endpoint
use_cases.description: Create a GET route that validates workspace access and filters Supabase results by workspace_id.

use_cases.title: Build a Workspace Creation Route
use_cases.description: Create a POST route that validates the request, writes workspace ownership fields, and returns a standard response.

use_cases.title: Review API Route Consistency
use_cases.description: Compare an endpoint against the checklist for error boundaries, Supabase access, workspace filtering, and TypeScript types.

prompt_templates.title: Create a GET Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Next.js 15 GET endpoint for [resource]. Use Supabase, workspaceId validation, withErrorBoundary, and standard success and error responses.

prompt_templates.title: Create a POST Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a POST endpoint for [resource]. Validate workspace access, parse the body, require [fields], and save workspace_id and created_by.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt an Existing Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this route for the skill checklist. Add missing workspace validation, Supabase server access, workspace_id filters, and standard responses.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Resource API Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan API endpoints for [resource]. Define GET and POST behavior, validation rules, workspace filtering, response handling, and production hardening notes.

output_examples.input: Create a GET endpoint for projects.
output_examples.output: A route outline that validates workspaceId, checks user access, queries projects by workspace_id, and returns a standard success response.

output_examples.input: Add a POST endpoint for tasks.
output_examples.output: A creation flow that parses the request body, checks required fields, stores workspace ownership, and returns the created task.

output_examples.input: Review this endpoint against the checklist.
output: Workspace access validation is required before database access.
Every table query should include workspace_id filtering.
Backend error details should be logged server-side, not returned to clients.

best_practices: Always validate workspace access before reading or writing tenant data.
Filter every Supabase query by workspace_id unless the table is global by design.
Replace raw backend error messages with safe client messages and server logs.
anti_patterns: Creating endpoints that trust workspaceId without validateUserAndWorkspace.
Writing records without workspace_id or created_by ownership metadata.
Returning database error details directly to client applications.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Next.js 15 API route handlers that use Supabase and workspace-scoped access checks.

faq.question: Does it include authentication helper code?
faq.answer: No. It assumes helpers such as validateUserAndWorkspace and getSupabaseServer already exist in the project.

faq.question: Can it generate POST endpoints?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a POST pattern for body parsing, basic validation, inserts, and ownership fields.

faq.question: Does it support every HTTP method?
faq.answer: No. The documented examples cover GET and POST patterns only.

faq.question: Is the pattern suitable for multi-tenant apps?
faq.answer: Yes. The checklist emphasizes workspace validation and workspace_id filters for tenant isolation.

faq.question: What should be changed before production use?
faq.answer: Add schema validation, sanitize error responses, consider rate limits, and test authorization behavior.
